ja178:1.1: The place of my birth, where I developed,
ja178:1.2: I lived thus on this mud,
ja178:1.3: And on this mud I will now die,
ja178:1.4: just like one of those who is weak.
ja178:1.5: This, just this, I say, O Bhaggava,
ja178:1.6: do you listen to my word:
ja178:2.1: Whether in the village or wilds,
ja178:2.3: (Although) knowing his place of birth and development, a person
ja178:2.5: Should live where’er he can go,
ja178:2.6: not staying when his home is destroyed.
